provider.name: Sandbox Mutual
provider.note: Fictional insurer for demonstration. Terms are not market quotes.

insured_value_rule.text: Cover is written up to the lower bound of the manager-confirmed indicative value range.

products.name: Basic Mortality & Accident
products.summary: Pays toward the loss of an insured animal that dies or is injured in an accident.

eligibility.text: The animal has a confirmed identity reference.
A manager-confirmed valuation is on file.

exclusions.text: Pre-existing injury or illness before the effective date.
Neglect, starvation, or failure to provide veterinary care.
Animals not recorded in the passport at the time of loss.
Loss caused by war, civil unrest, or confiscation.

payout_formula.note: Illustrative formula for this sample product only.

products.name: Mortality + Theft
products.summary: Adds theft cover to death and accident cover for animals with an ownership document on file.

eligibility.text: The animal has a confirmed identity reference.
A manager-confirmed valuation is on file.
An ownership document reference is on file.

exclusions.text: Pre-existing injury or illness before the effective date.
Neglect, starvation, or failure to provide veterinary care.
Animals not recorded in the passport at the time of loss.
Loss caused by war, civil unrest, or confiscation.
Theft without a police report filed within 72 hours.

products.name: Dairy Health Plus
products.summary: Covers illness and accidental injury for dairy cows with a recent veterinary health check.

eligibility.text: The animal has a confirmed identity reference.
A veterinary health check within the last 30 days.

exclusions.text: Pre-existing injury or illness before the effective date.
Neglect, starvation, or failure to provide veterinary care.
Animals not recorded in the passport at the time of loss.
Loss caused by war, civil unrest, or confiscation.
Illness first diagnosed within 14 days of the effective date.
